text:
maggie_sales: Quick heads-up — Keystone (enterprise POC) will pause unless governance + pricing questions are answered. They asked for BYO-KMS + VPC peering and want committed throughput pricing. Looping @raj_eng @elaine_se @jordan_pricing

raj_eng: Got it. Clarify: BYO-KMS required for Private/Dedicated only? For Hosted we can support AWS KMS via allowlist but need 1–2 day token flow change. VPC peering adds network ops work.

elaine_se: Security got the questionnaire. 5 open items: data residency, KMS integration, egress controls, audit logs retention, SSO/SAML proof. I'll draft responses but need security signoff for SOC2 attestation statement.

security_bot: Form submitted: Keystone_SecQ_2026-03-22.pdf — 5 unresolved items. https://redwood.internal/sec-forms/keystone

jordan_pricing: Pricing ask: customer expecting 30% discount if we commit to 12mo Dedicated. Need cost model + ops impact. @sam_engineering how soon can Dedicated be provisioned vs hosted burst?

sam_engineering: Dedicated provisioning ETA ~10 business days once contract signed + infra ticket. We can offer hosted with burst to meet POC for 2–4 weeks while dedicated is provisioned. Can enable autoscaling but throughput SLOs won't be SLA-backed.

maggie_sales: Action plan: 1) @jordan_pricing propose two options by 15:00 PT today — (A) hosted+burst trial + short-term credits; (B) 12mo dedicated commit with x% discount and SLA. 2) @raj_eng confirm KMS BYO feasibility & minimal technical steps by EOD. 3) @elaine_se get draft security responses and flag anything blocking SOC2 claim. I'll prep exec summary for customer and cc legal.

raj_eng: Quick technical note I'll drop in thread: Hosted flow requires a token relay to allow customer-managed keys; we need an allowlist and short-lived signed tokens. Pasting sample snippet:
```
# pseudo config
kms_integration:
  mode: hosted-token-relay
  allowlist: [keystone-account-id]
  token_ttl: 15m
```

elaine_se: On it — pinging security to prioritize. If SOC2 statement can't be provided we'll offer SOC2-type artifacts (audit logs + controls) as a fallback and call it out in SOW.

maggie_sales: Thanks — I'll escalate to legal if Jordan's pricing options push to exec review. Keep updates here. :thumbsup:
